title: tilwhen date engine
description: Deterministic date arithmetic with auditable receipts: business days, due dates, holidays.
summary: Deterministic date arithmetic with auditable receipts: business days, due dates, holidays.
offersHint: Deterministic date arithmetic with auditable receipts: business days, due dates, holidays. · Remote MCP (streamable-http) at https://mcp.tilwhen.com/mcp

toolsPreview.name: parse_date_query
toolsPreview.description: Parses queries like "90 business days from today in uganda" into a normalized operation, answers it, and returns the auditable receipt. Ambiguous dates (03/04/2027) return needsClarification instead of a guess.

toolsPreview.name: add_days
toolsPreview.description: The date N whole calendar days after a date (exclusive counting: the start date is day 0).

toolsPreview.name: subtract_days
toolsPreview.description: The date N whole calendar days before a date.

toolsPreview.name: days_between
toolsPreview.description: Signed whole calendar days from one date to another, midnight to midnight, endpoints exclusive (the gap).

toolsPreview.name: business_days
toolsPreview.description: Span mode (from+to): business days between two dates, exclusive of the start day, inclusive of the end day. Add mode (days, optional date): the date N business days away. Optional holiday jurisdiction or custom calendar, and a selectable working week.

toolsPreview.name: invoice_due
toolsPreview.description: Due date for Net-N payment terms (calendar days, invoice date = day 0). Optional roll-forward past weekends and, with a jurisdiction or custom calendar, public holidays.

toolsPreview.name: next_occurrence
toolsPreview.description: The next occurrence strictly after the base date (default today) of either a tracked event slug (e.g. "christmas") or a weekday (0 = Sunday .. 6 = Saturday). Provide exactly one of event/weekday.

toolsPreview.name: holidays
toolsPreview.description: Observed public holidays with the nominal (legal) date and status: rule (statutory) or declared (officially declared for that year). Declared-only holidays are omitted for undeclared years, with a holiday_data_incomplete warning.

toolsPreview.name: explain
toolsPreview.description: Runs any operation and returns the receipt plus human-readable derivation steps. Accepts the same fields as the other tools, discriminated by op.
